important_invariants: No fallible operation remains between scheduler/capacity/Ready publication; only admitted Woken/Yielded decisions prepare and deliver effects.
Core denial, stale discard, invalid/duplicate phase, checked arithmetic failure, replay divergence and preparation failure preserve complete scheduler/capacity state and add no delivery.
Rejected Yield retains Running ownership; explicit later commands are required after queue space is freed.
Active usage is phase-derived from Ready/Running/Blocked; Ready usage is the actual bounded Ready queue. Selection, block, terminal transitions and cleanup publish their exact changes.
Logical plan bounds are enforced independently of allocator-rounded physical capacity; runnable and Ready backing never widens.
Terminal rows are retained, never purged/reused. Full retained history overloads new identities through the existing policy even when active usage is zero; this does not implement F11 reclamation.
Post-publication delivery error returns CommittedEffectUncertain with committed state preserved and no automatic retry.
regressions_updated: Existing adapter regressions now drive owning APIs with actual receiving worker snapshots and independently consumed simulation deliveries.
Paired accepted/denied resume and Yield at active/Ready bounds under Reject and Backpressure; complete state/capacity equality and unchanged backing on denial.
FIFO/priority/wait refresh; stale callbacks versus current same-id target; wrong service/profile and owned capacity generation/profile/plan fences.
Invalid/duplicate commands, enqueue/choice overflow, deterministic replay divergence and required recorded-choice controls.
Terminal Complete/Cancel, generation cleanup, physical full-history overload, nonquiescent release denial and released-owner fencing.
Live missing-target preparation failure, simulation undrained-delivery preparation failure, explicit recovery after preparation succeeds, and committed effect uncertainty without retry.
Existing allocation-failure coverage now exercises both runnable and queue allocation failures through the activation mechanism that creates actual backing.
Removed obsolete direct-route regression and disconnected manually charged FIFO capacity test; their meaningful behavior is covered through the owner.
verification_and_remaining_limits: No build, test, lint, formatter, lifecycle or git commands executed, as assigned. Parent must format once and run the single post-edit acceptance campaign; there is no passing post-edit claim.
Literal callsite inventory found no remaining fabric_time direct .route(), old wake-test helpers, MaybeUninit reservations or removed scheduler helper references.
Parent established this worktree is not indexed by the available rust-analyzer instance; empty LSP reference responses were not treated as absence of callers.
Finite retained-history/full-backing exhaustion is intentional and documented; no terminal reclamation or fresh-occurrence reuse is claimed.
Simulation transport must be explicitly drained; a full pending-delivery queue causes prepublication Prepare failure, not scheduler overload or hidden retry.

Real thread observations are bounded local progress evidence, not liveness/performance guarantees. Canonical observations/snapshots remain allocating operations outside the allocation-free valid owner transition path.
